name: HB Multi-bracket
description: Implements DEHB's multi-bracket multi-fidelity strategy (Hyperband + Differential Evolution), replacing traditional random/Bayesian sampling with DE for high-quality candidates and leveraging Hyperband's hierarchical resource allocation to screen elites efficiently with limited budget.
code_block: from ConfigSpace import ConfigurationSpace, CategoricalHyperparameter; from dehb import DEHB;# Step 1: Core DEHB calling and implementation logic (Hyperband + DE + Multi-fidelity); def run_tuners(file, budget, seed, maxlives): random.seed(seed); independent_set = file.independent_set; used_budget = 0; consecutive_no_improve = 0; best_result = float('inf'); history_configs = {}; # Step 2: Construct ConfigurationSpace (matching independent set, for DEHB's parameter space definition); cs = ConfigurationSpace(seed=seed); for i, values in enumerate(independent_set): param = CategoricalHyperparameter(name=f'param_{i}', choices=values, default_value=values[0]); cs.add(param); dimensions = len(list(cs.values())); # Step 3: Initialize DEHB optimizer (core of Hyperband + DE + Multi-fidelity configuration); dehb = DEHB(cs=cs, dimensions=dimensions, min_fidelity=1, max_fidelity=2, eta=3, seed=seed, n_workers=1, output_path='./dehb_logs'); # Step 4: Iterative DEHB calling loop (ask-tell interface to trigger DE sampling and multi-bracket evaluation); while used_budget < budget and consecutive_no_improve < maxlives: # Ask DEHB for a new candidate config (generated via Differential Evolution); job_info = dehb.ask(); config = job_info['config']; # Convert DEHB config to list format matching evaluation requirement; config_list = [config[f'param_{i}'] for i in range(len(independent_set))]; # Evaluate the config and track budget/performance/non-improvement; ini_consecutive_no_improve = consecutive_no_improve; ini_used_budget = used_budget; used_budget, consecutive_no_improve, history_configs, best_result, score, similar_config = evaluate(used_budget, consecutive_no_improve, history_configs, best_result, config_list); # Skip if evaluation has no effective update; if ini_consecutive_no_improve == consecutive_no_improve - 1 and ini_used_budget == used_budget: continue; # Tell DEHB the evaluation result (to update DE population and Hyperband brackets); dehb.tell(job_info=job_info, result={'fitness': score, 'cost': 1}); # Break loop if budget or non-improvement constraint is hit; if used_budget >= budget or consecutive_no_improve >= maxlives: break; return best_result

elif isinstance(obj, np.ndarray): serializer._serialize(obj.tolist(), outputstream, indentlevel); elif isinstance(obj, np.str_): serializer._serialize(str(obj), outputstream, indentlevel); elif isinstance(obj, np.bool_): serializer._serialize(bool(obj), outputstream, indentlevel); else: raise serpent.Serializer.UnsupportedTypeError; # Register numpy serialization handler; serpent._special_classes_registry[np.integer] = numpy_serpent_handler; serpent._special_classes_registry[np.floating] = numpy_serpent_handler; unique_values = list(set(valid_values)); unique_values.sort(); cs.add(CS.CategoricalHyperparameter(name=param_name, choices=unique_values)); return cs; # Step 3: Core BOHB calling logic (Hyperband + Bayesian + Multi-fidelity); name: Momentum Model
description: Quantifies configuration performance uncertainty and predicts convergence via weighted linear regression on historical losses (or fixed values for insufficient data), outputting a (mu, sigma) distribution for candidate screening.
code_block: from scipy.stats import norm; for c in candidates_sorted: config_history = c['history']; losses = [h[2] for h in config_history]; t = len(losses); if t < 2: dist = (losses[-1], 1.0); else: k_list = np.array([[1 / i ** 0.5, 1 / i] for i in range(1, t + 1)]); A = np.hstack([np.ones((t, 1)), k_list]); W = np.diag([1 / (i ** 0.5) for i in range(1, t + 1)]); y = np.array(losses).reshape(-1, 1); beta = np.linalg.inv(A.T @ W @ A) @ A.T @ W @ y; mu = beta[0, 0]; sigma = np.var(y - A @ beta); dist = (float(mu), float(sigma)); c['dist'] = dist

name: Quantifying Uncertainty in the Training Process
description: Calculates the joint probability that top-k candidates contain the optimal solution using Gaussian CDF on their (mu, sigma) distributions, generating a probability array to quantify candidate quality uncertainty.
code_block: from scipy.stats import norm; candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x['current_score']); n = len(candidates_sorted); P = [0.0] * n; for k in range(n): top_k = candidates_sorted[:k + 1]; joint_prob = 1.0; for i in range(k + 1): mu_i, sigma_i = top_k[i]['dist']; for j in range(n): if j > k: mu_j, sigma_j = candidates_sorted[j]['dist']; prob = norm.cdf((mu_j - mu_i) / np.sqrt(sigma_i ** 2 + sigma_j ** 2)); joint_prob *= prob; P[k] = joint_prob

code_block: num_candidates = 1000; candidate_ei_list = []; for candidate_config in candidates: if tuner_model is None: ei_value = random.random(); else: ei_features = []; for i, val in enumerate(candidate_config): param_values = tuner_param_space[i]; ei_features.append(param_values.index(val)); y_preds = [tree.predict([ei_features])[0] for tree in tuner_model.estimators_]; mu = np.mean(y_preds); sigma = np.std(y_preds); incumbent_score_non_negative = max(tuner_incumbent_score, -1e-5) - (-1e-5) + 1e-5; incumbent_score_scaled = incumbent_score_non_negative * 1e5; f_min = np.log1p(incumbent_score_scaled); if sigma < 1e-6: ei_value = 0.0; else: z = (f_min - mu) / sigma; cdf = 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / np.sqrt(2))); pdf = np.exp(-0.5 * z ** 2) / np.sqrt(2 * np.pi); ei_value = (f_min - mu) * cdf + sigma * pdf; candidate_ei_list.append((candidate_config, ei_value)); candidate_ei_list.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True); next_config = candidate_ei_list[0][0]

name: Statistical Test for Elite Configuration Screening
description: Screens elite configurations using Friedman chi-square test (α=0.05), retaining candidates with ranks below the 80th percentile and truncating to a minimum elite size (N_min=2).
code_block: from scipy.stats import friedmanchisquare; alpha = 0.05; N_min = 2; if len(configs) > N_min: max_len = max(len(p) for p in performances); padded_performances = [p + [np.nan] * (max_len - len(p)) for p in performances]; perf_matrix = np.array(padded_performances).T; try: valid_cols = ~np.isnan(perf_matrix).any(axis=0); valid_perf_matrix = perf_matrix[:, valid_cols]; stat, p_value = friedmanchisquare(*valid_perf_matrix); except ValueError: stat, p_value = 0, 1.0; if p_value < alpha: avg_ranks = np.mean([np.argsort(np.argsort(perf)) for perf in valid_perf_matrix], axis=0); threshold = np.percentile(avg_ranks, 80); valid_generated = [cfg for cfg, valid in zip(generated_cfg_for_test, valid_cols) if valid]; survivors_generated = [cfg for cfg, rank in zip(valid_generated, avg_ranks) if rank <= threshold]; elite_generated = survivors_generated[:N_min]

name: Arm Weight Update

code_block: gamma = 0.1; score_min = min([v for v in history_configs.values()] + [current_score]); score_max = max([v for v in history_configs.values()] + [current_score]); if score_max == score_min: reward = 0.5; else: reward = (score_max - current_score) / (score_max - score_min); total_super_weight = sum(super_weights.values()); super_prob = (1 - gamma) * (super_weights[selected_super_arm] / total_super_weight) + gamma / k; exp_super = min(gamma * reward / (k * super_prob), 709); super_weights[selected_super_arm] *= np.exp(exp_super); total_sub_weight_update = sum(sub_weights[selected_super_arm].values()); sub_prob = sub_weights[selected_super_arm][selected_sub_arm] / total_sub_weight_update; exp_sub = min(gamma * reward / sub_prob, 709); sub_weights[selected_super_arm][selected_sub_arm] *= np.exp(exp_sub)

code_block: def sway_recursive(items, budget_rem):; if len(items) < enough or budget_rem <= 0:; return items, 0; rand_item = get_valid_rep(items); rand_int = convert_to_int(rand_item); east = max(items, key=lambda x: euclidean(convert_to_int(x), rand_int)); east_int = convert_to_int(east); west = max(items, key=lambda x: euclidean(convert_to_int(x), east_int)); c = euclidean(east_int, convert_to_int(west)); if c == 0:; mid = len(items) // 2; west_items, east_items = items[:mid], items[mid:]; else:; projections = [(item, (euclidean(convert_to_int(item), convert_to_int(west))**2 + c**2 - euclidean(convert_to_int(item), east_int)**2)/(2*c)) for item in items]; projections.sort(key=lambda x: x[1]); mid = len(projections) // 2; west_items, east_items = [p[0] for p in projections[:mid]], [p[0] for p in projections[mid:]]; a_reps, b_reps, total_cost = west, east, 0; a_better_flag = False; if budget_rem >= 2:; a_better_flag, cost = better(a_reps, b_reps, budget_rem); total_cost += cost; budget_rem -= cost; keep_west, keep_east = True, True; if a_better_flag:; keep_east = False; else:; if budget_rem >= 2:; b_better_flag, cost = better(b_reps, a_reps, budget_rem); total_cost += cost; budget_rem -= cost; if b_better_flag:; keep_west = False; result = []; if keep_west and budget_rem > 0:; west_res, cost = sway_recursive(west_items, budget_rem); result.extend(west_res); total_cost += cost; budget_rem -= cost; if keep_east and budget_rem > 0:; east_res, cost = sway_recursive(east_items, budget_rem); result.extend(east_res); total_cost += cost; budget_rem -= cost; return result, total_cost
